system.preference_demo: m041: I do not take meetings before 11:00am, ever. If anyone proposes something earlier, don't accept it -- offer 11:00am or later instead. Please remember this for future scheduling.

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a one-line reason, leaving none untouched.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all 24 messages, each with a disposition and reason, then the line 'undecided: 0'. Also writes decisions.json.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R1 (one 'decision' event per message id)

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply that is grounded in a specific earlier message and records the message ids it drew on.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft answering m008 that contains the staging URL from m003, plus a 'cited: [m003]' line. m003 really contains that URL.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R2 (a 'draft' event whose cited ids appear as earlier 'read' events)

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without either per-action approval or an explicit --dry-run that shows what it would do.
capabilities.observable: Prints every send/delete it WOULD perform, then 'outbox/ writes: 0' because dry-run suppresses them. Re-running without --dry-run prompts y/n before each send.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R3 ('gate' events recording proposed action and decision)

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference and retrieves it on a later run after the process has fully exited.
capabilities.observable: First invocation reads m041 and stores the preference 'I do not take meetings before 11:00am, ever. If anyone proposes something earlier, don't accept it -- offer 11:00am or later instead.' in memory.json. After the process exits, running `python demo.py --cap R4 --recall` starts a fresh process and retrieves the saved meeting preference.
capabilities.evidence: memory.json on disk between runs; console output from the --recall run

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to the assistant inside message bodies, refuses them, flags them, and reports them to the user.
capabilities.observable: Scans the inbox and flags m017, m024, m039, and m047 as messages containing instructions aimed at the assistant. It refuses to follow those instructions, leaves the messages in place, and writes no external action to outbox/.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, refusal events naming m017, m024, m039, and m047 with the attempted action and reason

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane view (pending actions, flagged, commitments) reproducible from a run, with commitments cited to source messages and conflicts surfaced.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html and dashboard.json with pending actions, flagged messages, commitments, and conflicts. The run flags m017, m024, m039, and m047, and reports 'CONFLICT: m010 and m061 share day 15 at 3:00pm'.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html and dashboard.json containing the four panes and the conflict record

capabilities.name: Unread mail by sender
capabilities.claim: Lists all unread messages from a given sender using case-insensitive sender matching.
capabilities.observable: Prints and writes unread_mail.json with unread_count 5 and records for m001, m005, m029, m035, and m013 from raghav@paperjet.io. Sender matching is case-insensitive, and a sender with no unread mail returns an empty messages list.
capabilities.evidence: unread_mail.json; trace.jsonl event with cap=X1, event=unread_mail_listed, the normalized sender, and the returned message ids

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds messages I sent that nobody has answered in 3+ days, and drafts a chase for each.
capabilities.observable: Prints and writes followups.json with one follow-up for m044, which was sent to Priya and has been waiting 18 days as of 2026-09-20. The file includes its thread id, recipient, subject, waiting time, and a drafted chase; m003 is excluded because m005 replied in its thread.
capabilities.evidence: followups.json; trace.jsonl event(s) with cap=X2, event=followup_drafted, message_id, thread_id, and days_waiting

capabilities.name: Automatic deadline tracker
capabilities.claim: Extracts concrete deadlines from messages, classifies them as overdue, due today, or upcoming, and cites the source message.
capabilities.observable: Prints and writes deadlines.json with nine source-linked deadline records for 2026-09-20: eight overdue records for m028, m030, m117, m042, m111, m018, m046, and m048, plus the upcoming month-end deadline for m055 on 2026-09-30. Each record includes message_id, subject, deadline, deadline_text, and status.
capabilities.evidence: deadlines.json; trace.jsonl events with cap=X3 and event=deadline_extracted, including each source message_id and status
